title: EMBLEM: Enhancing Multi-script Table Detection through Masking
abstract: arXiv:2609.08330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Table detection is a core task in document analysis, supporting downstream applications such as information retrieval, document reconstruction, and visual question answering. While existing deep learning models perform well on English and Chinese documents, they struggle with multilingual, multi-script documents due to script diversity and the limited availability of labeled data. To address this challenge, we introduce MANDALA (Multi-script Annotated Documents for Table Detection), a manually curated dataset of 2,323 table-containing pages spanning 18 languages and 15 scripts across diverse domains. We also propose EMBLEM, a masking-based paradigm for Multi-script Table Detection (MTD). EMBLEM generates masked images that conceal script- and font-specific details, enabling models pre-trained on abundant English documents to focus on script-agnostic page layout. translated_title: EMBLEM：通过掩码技术增强多文字系统表格检测
translated_abstract: 表格检测是文档分析中的一项核心任务，为信息检索、文档重建和视觉问答等下游应用提供支持。尽管现有的深度学习模型在英文和中文文档上表现良好，但由于文字系统的多样性以及标注数据的有限性，它们在多语言、多文字系统的文档上表现不佳。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了MANDALA（用于表格检测的多文字系统标注文档），这是一个人工整理的数据集，包含2,323个含表格的页面，涵盖18种语言和15种文字系统，跨越多个不同领域。我们还提出了EMBLEM，这是一种基于掩码的多文字系统表格检测（MTD）范式。EMBLEM通过生成掩码图像来隐藏与文字系统和字体相关的特定细节，使在大量英文文档上预训练的模型能够专注于与文字系统无关的页面布局。在三种表格检测架构上的实验表明，EMBLEM持续取得优异表现……
tldr: 该论文推出了包含18种语言、15种文字系统的人工标注数据集MANDALA，并提出基于掩码的EMBLEM方法，通过隐藏文字和字体特征使英文预训练模型能够有效泛化到多文字系统的表格检测任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MANDALA, a manually curated dataset spanning 18 languages and 15 scripts, and proposes EMBLEM, a masking-based paradigm that conceals script- and font-specific details to enable English pre-trained models to generalize to multi-script table detection.
